description.narrative: Tecnomyl S.A. (Tecnomyl or the Company) is an agrochemicals producer and wholesale distributor, headquartered in Villeta, Paraguay. Founded in 1991, the Company has over 30 years of experience formulating and commercializing post-patent crop protection products such as herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and fertilizers. The proposed investment consists of: (i) an A loan facility of up to US$20 million to support the construction and expansion of a biological products plant in Villeta, the development of a logistics center in Ciudad del Este, and to finance related working capital needs; and (ii) an A loan facility of up to US$100 million to be made available through five one-year commitments of up to US$20 million each to support the operations of Tecnomyl (the Project).

The Project will support Paraguays economy by establishing a biological inputs plant and a logistics center, contributing to new employment and higher value added. It will also expand the use of biological crop protection products, improving soil health, strengthening resilience to climate shocks, and promoting more sustainable farming practices.
